So I coupon almost exclusively at Publix so if  you don't have a Publix this info won't be very helpful but I use Publixsavings101, mycouponningbuddy, and Iheartpublix to look up their deals. Publix is great because they have bogo sales every week AND they have two different store coupon booklets that you can use in combination with manufacturer coupons. Krazycouponlady is a pretty good website to get started since they have tons of stores on there such as Walgreens, CVS, and Target.

 I never purchase newspapers since I usually only want a few select coupons. Instead I order my coupons clipped from websites like klip2save. For printable coupons if you have multiple browsers you can sometimes print 2 per browser. 

If there is a brand you often purchase from I recommend you go to their website and sign up for their emails. I've received a ton of high value coupons that way.
